task_title: Ship landlock-net-loader.py via install.sh and surface the bridge's landlock-net degrade warning
task_criteria: install.sh copies standalone/landlock-net-loader.py into the installed LIB_DIR (same block that copies seccomp-loader.py and landlock-loader.py, install.sh ~1219-1227)
the installed layout ~/.local/lib/terminal-jail/ contains landlock-net-loader.py after a fresh ./install.sh run

the wrapper no longer discards the bridge's stderr wholesale: a landlock-net degrade warning emitted by the bridge on stderr reaches the operator's terminal, while the bridge's stdout JSON contract consumed by _interruptor_evaluate stays intact
with TERMINAL_JAIL_LANDLOCK_NET=1 and the loader missing, the probe payload's connect() behavior either enforces or the operator sees the loud degrade warning — never silent
regression tests cover the install.sh copy list (packaging/install test scope) and pass: .venv/bin/python -m pytest plugin -q
